# PdfVersion

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Specifies the PDF version for the output document.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `Pdf14`: PDF 1.4 (default). RC4 encryption support.
- `Pdf17`: PDF 1.7. AES-256 encryption, PDF/A-1b compliance, XMP metadata, and bookmarks.
- `Pdf20`: PDF 2.0 (ISO 32000-2). Foundation for PDF/A-4 and PDF/UA-2; initially feature-equivalent to PDF 1.7 output.
